title: About TSU
heroSubheading: A public university committed to accessible, high-quality education across nine faculties.

children.text: Taraba State University was established to expand access to quality higher education for the people of Taraba State and the wider region. Since then, it has grown into a multi-faculty institution offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and distance learning programs.
The university's main campus sits in Jalingo, with academic activity spanning nine faculties and dozens of departments, serving a growing student population drawn from across Nigeria.

title: Admissions
heroSubheading: Undergraduate, postgraduate, and distance learning pathways into TSU — here's what you need to know before you apply.

children.text: Undergraduate applicants are admitted through UTME (Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination) or Direct Entry, followed by TSU's own post-UTME screening exercise. Applicants should meet the minimum O'Level requirements for their intended programme, including relevant credit passes in English and Mathematics.

Postgraduate admissions are coordinated through the School of Postgraduate Studies. Applicants apply through the postgraduate portal, upload transcripts and credentials, and — depending on the programme — sit a written or oral screening exercise before an offer is issued.
Minimum UTME score as published for the session, five O'Level credits including English and Mathematics, and a valid JAMB registration for Taraba State University as first or second choice.
A relevant ND, NCE, HND, or A-Level qualification, plus the standard five O'Level credit requirement, for entry into 200 level of an approved programme.
A first degree from a recognized university in a relevant field, with the minimum CGPA published by the School of Postgraduate Studies for the specific programme applied for.

title: Alumni
heroSubheading: Graduates of Taraba State University carrying the university's name into every sector of public and professional life.

children.text: The TSU Alumni Association exists to keep graduates connected to the university and to each other — through reunions, mentorship programs, and opportunities to give back to current students.
Alumni interested in mentoring current students, contributing to scholarship funds, or reconnecting with their department can reach out through the Alumni Relations Office.

title: Campuses
heroSubheading: Taraba State University's academic activity is anchored at its main campus in Jalingo, Taraba State.

children.text: The main campus in Jalingo houses the majority of TSU's faculties, administrative offices, the university library, and student housing. It serves as the primary hub for undergraduate academic life.
Campus facilities include lecture theatres, faculty-specific laboratories and workshops, a central library, student affairs offices, and sporting facilities.

title: Careers
heroSubheading: Academic and administrative opportunities at Taraba State University.

children.text: Taraba State University periodically recruits academic staff, administrative staff, and support personnel across its faculties and departments. Open positions are announced through official university channels.
There are no active vacancies published at this time. Check back periodically, or contact the Registry for information on upcoming recruitment exercises.

title: Giving
heroSubheading: Every gift strengthens scholarships, research, and campus facilities for the next generation of TSU students.

children.text: Gifts to Taraba State University directly support student scholarships, laboratory and library upgrades, and research initiatives across the university's nine faculties.

The university accepts contributions from alumni, corporate partners, and friends of the institution. For current donation channels and account details, please contact the Advancement/Bursary Office directly — official banking details are issued only through verified university channels, never listed informally.

title: Library
heroSubheading: Supporting research and learning across every faculty with print and digital resources.

children.text: The university library serves as the central academic resource hub for TSU students and staff, offering print collections, reading spaces, and access to digital research databases.
Registered students and staff can access online journal databases and e-book collections remotely using their university credentials.

title: Research
heroSubheading: Faculty-led research spanning agriculture, health, engineering, and the social sciences.

children.text: TSU faculty and postgraduate students conduct research across agriculture, public health, engineering, and social sciences, with particular strength in work addressing regional development challenges in Taraba State and the wider Middle Belt.
The university pursues research funding through bodies such as TETFund, alongside partnerships with government agencies and other academic institutions.

title: TETFund

children.text: TETFund-supported infrastructure projects at TSU, covering lecture halls, laboratories, and other academic facilities. Specific project details to be added as they are confirmed.
Sponsorship support for academic staff pursuing higher qualifications (Master's and PhD) both locally and abroad.
Support for expanding the university library's print and digital collections.
Institution-based research grants awarded to TSU faculty for approved research projects.
